text: This report summarizes the program items at the Community Liaison Consultation in person and virtual meeting held on November 15, 2023. Hosting the meeting was Board Member Peter Leon. Exhibition Place staff in attendance included Kelvin Seow - Chief People and Strategy Officer, Judy Mahoney - Director, Sales and Marketing, Prashant Bhalja - Director, Capital Works, LongFei Chen, IT Systems, Catherine de Nobriga, Tenant and Community Relations Coordinator, and Debbie Sanderson, Executive Assistant to the CEO. Fifteen (15) community members attended the meeting; four (4) in person and eleven (11) virtually. The meeting lasted approximately one and one-half hours.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (January 19, 2024) from the Chief Financial Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
